title: Gokujou Parodius Da! Deluxe Pack
native_title: 極上パロディウスだ！ ＤＥＬＵＸＥ ＰＡＣＫ
overview:
Two Big Laughs on One Disc. This Is the Blissful Parodius.

To the X tens of thousands of "Gokujou Parodius" fans across the country, and the Y tens of thousands of "Parodius Da!" fans across the country: thank you for waiting so long. The side-splitting "Gokujou Parodius Da!" that Parodius freaks have been waiting for has finally arrived on the Saturn. A dream co-starring of a masterpiece and a classic in perfect ports!

This disc packs two arcade side-scrolling shooters that poke fun at Konami's own classics. Fly through absurd stages full of giant showgirls, mermaids and other oddities, shooting everything in sight and collecting power-up capsules to choose your upgrades from the power gauge, plus bells with special effects.

- Parodius Da!: pick from four pilots, including Vic Viper, Octopus, TwinBee and Pentarou
- Gokujou Parodius: twice as many playable characters and bigger stages
- One or two players

1枚で2度爆笑。これぞ至福のパロディウス。

全国X万人の「極上パロディウス」ファンの皆様、そして全国Y万人の「パロディウスだ!」ファンの皆様、本当にお待たせしました。パロディウスフリーク待望、抱腹絶倒の「極上パロディウスだ!」ついにサターンに登場。傑作と名作が完全移植で夢の共演!
